title: Spacetime Spell Core
text: Combine three Time Warp Points and three Spatial Crystals inside the Advanced Assembly Table. Place a Time Microcore, a Light/Dark Spell Core and a Space Microcore on its left, middle and right nodes to make one Spacetime Spell Core. Equip it as a spell core, power machinery with it, or use it in the Ritual of Time's Threshold to open a permanent mirror portal.
